title: TRIGR ON HYPERLIQUID
summary_title: Why AI is terrible at trading, and what TRIGR built instead
summary_description: Jeremy from Trigger explains why LLMs fail at trading, and how Trigger's strategy marketplace solves it with 1,000+ live-tested strategies on Hyperliquid.

key_moments.label: AI is terrible at trading — millions of predictions proved it
LLMs trained for mean reversion, best traders use standard deviation
Pivot: AI is good at coding, so build strategy builders instead
Overfitting trap: backtest looks great, live trading fails
Trigger's solution: 1,000 strategies frozen, tested live for 100+ days
Strategies boost prop firm pass rates from 15% to 30-70%
Build custom strategies with third-party APIs, almost like personal vaults
Long-term moat: network of thousands building, thousands of live-validated strategies
